title: Projection-Based Parareal for Nonlinear Initial-Value Problems
summary: Parareal is a parallel-in-time method for initial-value problems that has found extensive applications and given rise to many variants. Krylov-enhanced parareal is a variant of parareal that uses projection techniques to accelerate convergence substantially for linear problems. In this paper, we study a projection-based parareal algorithm for nonlinear initial-value problems with a modified iteration scheme and an arbitrary orthogonal projection.
